name: Tender.fi GMXPriceOracle tGMX price 1e20 decimal inflation
summary: Tender.fi activated a new GMXPriceOracle whose tGMX branch multiplied a price already scaled by 1e20 by another 1e10, returning the GMX price with 38 instead of 18 decimals. While it was live, healthy GMX borrowers became liquidatable for wei-sized repayments, and one GMX of collateral let an attacker borrow about $1.59m of every other market's assets.

loss.notes: Two campaigns merged. (1) 2023-03-07 07:13 UTC: liquidation bot 0x3ac52d0e (EOA 0x14c07a5f) liquidated two healthy GMX borrowers for 3 and 1 wei of GMX and redeemed 18.681895076176123477 ETH of their seized tETH; the protocol seize share that went to Tender reserves is excluded. (2) 08:24-08:44 UTC: attacker 0x896df375 supplied about 1 GMX and made 27 defect-enabled borrows, listed at their exact Borrow amounts. The first borrow, 0.01 ETH, was within legitimate capacity and is excluded. The attacker's collateral is not netted. The attacker later repaid the debt and kept 62.158670296 ETH as a bounty; that return does not reduce gross loss.

ageReset.description: Tender's Safe called Comptroller _setPriceOracle, moving the oracle pointer from 0x4df9b2246bb592823fa60872e4f1a636f1be7473 to this GMXPriceOracle. No later NewPriceOracle event occurs before the exploit; the fix at block 67558205 reverted the pointer.

sources.note: Root cause (source-8): GMXPriceOracle.getUnderlyingPrice returns getGmxPrice().mul(1e10) for symbol tGMX, and getGmxPrice() already returns Chainlink GMX/USD 0xdb98056fecfff59d032ab628337a4887110df3db latestAnswer (8 decimals) times 1e20, so the tGMX price mantissa carries 38 instead of 18 decimals (1e20 too large). The contract has no setters; the tGMX branch reads no mutable local state. eth_call getUnderlyingPrice(0x20a6768f6aabf66b787985ec6ce0ebea6d7ad497) returns 7146889000000000000000000000000000000000 on the new oracle at block 67432369 vs 71008116390000000000 on the previous oracle 0x4df9b2246bb592823fa60872e4f1a636f1be7473 at block 67432368. Comptroller 0xeed247ba513a8d6f78be9318399f5ed1a4808f8e oracle() (storage slot 4) is 0x4df9...7473 at 67432368 and 0x6141...272d at 67432369 through 67544532; NewPriceOracle logs (topic 0xd52b2b9b...) on the Comptroller over blocks 0..latest: 67432369:1:1 (4df9 -> 6141, Safe 0x80b54e18e5bb556c6503e1c6f2655749c9e41da2 execTransaction calling _setPriceOracle 0x55ee1fe1) and the fix 67558205:1:1 (6141 -> 0x626fee808a206df7529b5ab7e5a6e8fc98509cea, timestamp 1678182168). Earliest exercise: eth_getLogs over all 11 Comptroller markets (getAllMarkets at 67539636) for Borrow 0x13ed6866..., Redeem 0xe5b754fb..., LiquidateBorrow 0x298637f6... and cToken Transfer between 67432369 and 67558205. LiquidateBorrow: exactly two, both on tGMX: source-1 (block 67523467 idx 1, ts 1678173205; EOA 0x14c07a5f107a9d15a6c2d0c131dcb3933386503e via bot 0x3ac52d0e9f941187d1426f6294ac9481087d871e, which flash-borrowed 3 wei GMX from pair 0x05c6f695ad50c16299bedca3fe9059b56550082f) repaid 3 wei GMX of borrower 0x5c85361a473fa122997c54bcbd152a386cfd4bb8 and seized 70,657,368,353 tETH (log 64: 68,678,962,040 to liquidator; log 65: 1,978,406,313 protocol share), then redeemed 68,678,962,040 tETH for 14.011421307234099255 ETH (Redeem log 70; callTracer shows native transfer tETH -> bot). Tx 0x8498e6eb...9957 (67523486 idx 1) repaid 1 wei GMX of 0x41510ce93a97bca67bc09c05aa12023eb645fa38, seized 22,892,987,346 + 659,468,771 tETH and redeemed 4.670473768942024222 ETH (log 30). The trace of source-1 has the Comptroller call getUnderlyingPrice(tGMX) returning 0x152156915c64b957ed5603531ec0000000 (~7.19e39). With eth_call state override Comptroller slot 4 := old oracle 0x4df9...7473, getAccountLiquidity at block-1 gives both borrowers positive liquidity (4647.257734282560810507e18 and 1992.363132846127895091e18, shortfall 0) while the real state gives shortfall 1.73e42 and 7.78e41: the liquidations were enabled only by the defect. Borrow: 72 events in the window; only borrowers 0x2cad2e8592c20b38f2811eb4f35669a8f45e038a, 0x75e4c0ffb05c07798e22605b607e2c8717a1e885 and the attacker 0x896df3759205c141c97640b2b7345fa479feb1ab held tGMX at block-1; with the old-oracle override the first two have zero shortfall after every borrow (legitimate). The attacker (funded 67538428, minted tGMX with ~1 GMX in 0xaebc68fa... at 67539272) borrowed 28 times, 67539637..67544532; the first (0x5323e4d6..., 0.01 ETH) leaves 27.645622331998202532e18 legitimate liquidity under the override and is excluded; from 0xd673a0e8... (67539877:3, 0.1 ETH) onward every borrow leaves an old-oracle shortfall, ending at 1,591,752.910609613290380953e18 after 0xf14df8a4... No Redeem or cToken Transfer by any tGMX holder in the window relied on the price (all non-mint cToken transfers are the two seizures). Loss (gross, pre-return): liquidations 18.681895076176123477 ETH taken by the liquidator; the 0.537 ETH protocol seize share (ReservesAdded 0x0599f35565f64fdb and 0x01ddfbc721fcc549 wei) moved to Tender reserves and is excluded; GMX repaid (4 wei) is negligible. Attacker: sum of 27 Borrow amounts, cross-checked against receipts' ERC-20 Transfer(market -> attacker) logs and callTracer native value from tETH: 198.7 ETH, 641,690.1 USDC.e, 16 WBTC, 8798.00000100001 UNI, 50,011.100000001 DAI, 36,700 USDT, 24,975.000000000001 FRAX, 16,203.0000000001 LINK. Attacker-supplied ~1 GMX collateral is not netted; the later return of funds (e.g. 0x12a628c5... repayBorrowBehalf 136.6 ETH, and the 62.158670296 ETH retained as bounty) does not reduce gross loss. Prices: DefiLlama historical, requested at 1678173205 (liquidation ETH), 1678178644 (attacker ETH, WBTC, UNI, FRAX) and 1678178400 (USDC.e, DAI, USDT, LINK, so that every quote time precedes realizedAt); USDC.e is valued at the USDC quote. Total $1,621,046.03; attacker share $1,591,657.17 matches the reported $1.59m and the oracle shortfall above. realizedAt = last attacker borrow 67544532 (1678178644).

Target history: GMXPriceOracle 0x614157925d4b6f7396cde6434998bfd04789272d created top-level by 0x85abbc0f8681c4fb33b6a3a601ad99e92a32d1ac in 0x0ed73362540eaf4f3c0923ee8408d75c82f52d169eb56e2f68ae7dafbb664ca5 (block 67428680 idx 2, ts 1678145795; receipt contractAddress matches). eth_getCode is 0x at 67428679; keccak256(runtime) = 0x4a715af24a87ba70a5b075ee2bfa51b68a8cda4e48bc2bbcfd131a0b1b15ec07 at 67428680, 67523466 and 67544531. No proxy, no setters, no selfdestruct in verified source. Activation for the Comptroller execution context: NewPriceOracle(oldPriceOracle, newPriceOracle) at 0x7f20fe5bf475d2d48dbca8df07ac28cf84e04f4106e44bc318722737c09b447b block 67432369 idx 1 log 1 (ts 1678146970), data word 1 = 0x6141...272d; slot-4 read confirms the pointer before/after. It is the only NewPriceOracle between deployment and the fix at 67558205, so activation is the latest reset. Code age = 1678173205 - 1678146970 = 26,235 s. The Comptroller and tToken code consumed the price as designed and were not reset; the defect is solely in this oracle's tGMX branch.

limitations: The anchor is a liquidation by an apparently generic liquidation bot, not by the publicly reported attacker; it is the earliest successful transaction that benefits from the defective tGMX price.
